The clinical picture of a painful, ulcerative leg lesion with a necrotic base and raised borders, in the absence of vascular insufficiency or local trauma, is highly suggestive of Pyoderma Gangrenosum, a neutrophilic dermatosis often associated with systemic inflammation.
